name: vlmkit
description: Deterministic frontend quality gates as one automatic agent skill: verify markup, build it from a screenshot, generate Playwright tests, or draw a checked figure.

plugins.name: vlmkit
plugins.description: Automatic frontend quality router. Describe the outcome — implement this mock, check this page, turn these criteria into tests, explain how this works — and it picks one of 17 bundled workflows and runs its deterministic gates to green. No API key: the gates are Playwright + pixel math, and the agent's own vision is the only VLM.
